title: W3Schools: Python String Slicing
description: Given a string `s`, extract and return the substring from index `start` to `end` with step `step`.
constraints:
-1000 <= start, end, step <= 1000, step != 0
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(N)
starter_code:
def slice_string(s: str, start: int, end: int, step: int) -> str:
    pass
solution:
def slice_string(s: str, start: int, end: int, step: int) -> str:
    return s[start:end:step]
explanation: Python slice indexing s[start:end:step] extracts substrings in O(N) time.
